title: 401 endpoint serves RFC 9728 metadata naming at least one issuer
rationale: The known-conforming baseline for the OAuth funnel. It also fixes the denominator question that made the pilot's 36.7% PRM figure misleading: this endpoint answered 401, so it opted into authorization and RFC 9728 applies to it. An endpoint that never returns 401 is not measured here at all.

spec.quote: MCP servers MUST implement OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (RFC9728). MCP clients MUST use OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata for authorization server discovery.
The Protected Resource Metadata document returned by the MCP server MUST include the `authorization_servers` field containing at least one authorization server.
